description.value:
Your stumbling and bumbling can provide a brief distraction that renders an enemy unprepared for an attack. You Drop Prone, then attempt a @Check[deception|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of a target within 30 feet who can see you.

Critical Success The target is completely distracted by your fall. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] against attacks from creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

Success The target's attention is momentarily diverted to you. It's off-guard against the next attack a creature other than you attempts against it before the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure Your pratfall turns into a real fall. You take @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage.
